arguments.value: Faith S. Hochberg is a former United States District Judge for the District of New Jersey, serving from 1999 until her retirement in 2015. Born in East Orange, New Jersey, she earned a B.A. from Tufts University and a J.D. from Harvard Law School. Her career included federal clerkship service with Judge Spottswood Robinson, work at the Securities and Exchange Commission, private practice in Newark, service as an Assistant U.S. Attorney, senior counsel and deputy assistant secretary roles at the U.S. Department of the Treasury, and appointment as U.S. Attorney for the District of New Jersey before her judicial nomination by President Bill Clinton.
